title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Addlestone, Surrey (5 days in the office)

30,000 - 40,000 basic + uncapped OTE 50,000 - 60,000+

Looking to build a successful career in sales with uncapped earning potential?

We're partnering with a market-leading recruitment business specialising in the Fire & Security sector. With a long-standing reputation and established client relationships, this is an opportunity to join a high-performing team where you'll be given the tools, training and support to succeed from day one.

What you'll be doing:
- Winning new business and developing client relationships
- Speaking with key decision-makers across the Fire & Security industry
- Booking and attending client meetings
- Managing and growing your own portfolio of accounts
- Working closely with delivery teams to match top talent with leading businesses

What we're looking for:
- Ambitious, driven and commercially minded individuals
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Sales, business development, customer service, hospitality, retail or recruitment experience welcomed
- Motivated by progression and earning potential

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, thrives in a target-driven environment and wants genuine career progression with a business that invests in its people.

Interested? Apply today!

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Technical and After Sales Advisor
description:
Technical & Aftersales Advisor

Are you someone who enjoys solving technical problems and helping customers find the right solution?

We're recruiting for a Technical & Aftersales Advisor to join a highly respected manufacturer within the construction and building services sector.

This is a varied position where you'll become the go-to person for technical support, product advice and aftersales enquiries. You'll work closely with customers, installers and internal teams, helping to resolve issues, provide expert guidance and ensure an excellent customer experience.

The Role:
- Provide technical advice and product support to customers and installers
- Manage aftersales enquiries from initial contact through to resolution
- Investigate technical issues and recommend solutions
- Coordinate replacement products, returns and warranty-related queries
- Build strong relationships with customers and distribution partners

What we're looking for:
- Customer facing experience either face to face or on the phone.
- Able to explain technical information in a clear and customer-friendly manner
- Ideally from construction products, HVAC, engineering or building services but any technical background will be considered.
- Organised, proactive and committed to delivering great customer service.

What's on Offer:

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and growing business where you'll receive ongoing training, develop specialist technical knowledge and build a long-term career within a supportive team environment.

This is a hybrid role, 2 days in the office, 3 days at home.

Package: £30-36,000, 5% Bonus, 25 Days Holiday, Private Healthcare, Pension
